content: Do you want to go play tennis with me tomorrow morning?
That would be fun, but I need to pick up my passport from the police station.
Are you going on a trip?
Yes, I'm going to the UK with my dad next month.
Not really, he is going on a business trip in London and I'm going with him to check out a few universities that I might apply for next year.
Sounds great, so how long will you be there?
I'm going to be in London for 5 days, after that I will visit a couple of cities in Schottland as well.
Checking out some schools there, too?
Exactly, well, have a nice weekend and see you at school on Monday.
